blocks.text: Car ke suspension system ke shock absorbers (Fig. 14.16) damped oscillation ki practical (amali) application hain. Oonchi neechi, kharab sarak par car spring ki wajah se bohat zyada uchhalti; shock absorbers in excessive oscillations (faltu jhoolon) ko damping se jaldi khatam kar dete hain, taa ke musafiron ka safar aaramdeh rahe.

blocks.alt: Gari ka pahiya (wheel) suspension ke baazuon aur shock absorber se jura hai; shock absorber ke gird coil spring lipta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.16: Gari ka suspension system (kitab ki Figure 14.16 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: Car ke suspension system mein critical damping kyun pasand ki jati hai?
blocks.explanation: Critical damping car ki body ko baghair jhoole sab se kam waqt mein apni jagah (equilibrium) par le aati hai. Is se car baar baar uchhalti nahi, safar aaramdeh rehta hai aur suspension agle jhatke (bump) ke liye foran tayyar ho jata hai.

items: Damping: resistive forces amplitude ko waqt ke saath kam karti hain.
Light (kai dafa jhoolta), critical (sab se jaldi wapsi, jhoolna nahi), heavy (bohat aahista wapsi).
